name: VRExplorer
summary:
VRExplorer is an immersive virtual reality platform for exploring, analyzing and collaborating within large-scale, complex 3D scenes. Teams meet in the same virtual environment to visualize, examine and discuss projects as if they were on site.
### IMPORTANT: ACCOUNT REQUIRED
